## Description
Provide a clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or improved in ApexAstro.

## Problem Statement
Is this feature request related to a problem or workflow limitation? If so, describe it.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working or what you'd like to achieve.

## Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature? Provide examples of when this would be useful.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds?

## Additional Context
Add any other context or references (screenshots, examples, etc.) that might be helpful.
